caption: The drawing depicts two clear glass bottles positioned side-by-side on a neutral, light-colored background. Each bottle has a greenish-black stopper at the top and shares roughly the same size and shape, with rounded shoulders and cylindrical bodies. The left bottle displays a symmetrical white decorative pattern with spirals and leaf-like motifs vertically aligned on the front face. The right bottle features a different white decorative pattern with geometric and spiral shapes, including X-like forms and curves, also arranged vertically. Beneath the left and right bottles, a simple horizontal scale is shown in black. The drawing has a realistic style, detaining the light reflections and subtle shadows on the transparent surfaces of the glass bottles. The signatures "Batel de Lemberg" appears lightly in the lower right corner.
title: Cordial Bottle
